statement.name: Target quotient cusp specialization d=6,k=2: norm recurrence has remainder 1-12T+66T^2-220T^3 modulo T^4
statement.source: Frozen target_quotient protocol, polynomial-minor control at A=B=X=0. The fixed d=6,k=2 recurrence h(T) is compared with an explicit remainder plus T^4 times a quotient from the closed binomial coefficients. Evaluation over one field only; neither the generic-minor theorem nor a radical-quotient rank theorem is certified.
